Jin: Heads up — during solace-v1 int8 bringup I hit a detokenize drift when Han chars sit next to Arabic sequences with ZWJ and brackets. BLEU drop on zh+ar blend tests. minimal repro below, need eyes. :eyes:
Alex: Can you paste the minimal repro + model + quant config?
Jin: repro + quick outputs:
```
input = "汉字‍(عربي) ١٢٣ [مثال]…"
# model: solace-v1
# quant: q4_0 baseline vs int8 (kernel set: auto)
# tokenizer: custom-detok v2 (normalizer=NFC)

# q4 output:
"汉字(عربي) ١٢٣[مثال]..."
# int8 output:
"汉字 ‍ (عربي) ١٢٣ [ مثال ]…"
```
(Jin: note the bracket spacing and ellipsis U+2026 preserved vs expanded)
Sophia: Hmm — looks like ZWJ (U+200D) handling plus bracket adjacency is changing token boundary. Did you try normalizer=NFKC and preserve_zwj=true? That flag changed a similar case for vertical text.
Jin: Tried NFKC -> reduces token merges but not fixed. preserve_zwj=true changes token ids around the boundary but final detok still inconsistent between q4->int8.
Alex: Can you dump token ids around the region for both runs (q4 vs int8)? Also include tokenizer config and any custom post-detok rules.
Jin: token ids (context window around boundary): q4: [234,1021,4096,0,5423]  int8: [234,1021,0,4096,5423] — you can see the 0 (ZWJ) moves. tokenizer config: preserve_zwj=false by default, grapheme_normalize=NFC, bracket_rule=surround_space=false.
Kai: That 0 shifting smells like kvcache/prefix-merge side-effects during kernel selection — the runtime sometimes fuses small tokens when batching changes. Try disabling kvcache and rerun the int8 smoke. Also dump raw logits around boundary.
Jin: Disabled kvcache, re-ran. Token ids still reorder, logits show reduced confidence on boundary token (prob shift ~0.12). Attached small log snippet.
Maria: eval-bot snapshot: we see BLEU drop and chrF delta between q4 and int8 on the multilang-cjk-ar testset.
eval-bot: EVAL: snapshot_id=202315, testset=multilang-cjk-ar, BLEU_q4=27.4, BLEU_int8=24.9, chrF_q4=52.1, chrF_int8=49.9, top_diff_cases=15
Sophia: If kernel fusion changes token emission order, detok can collapse differently (especially with invisible joiners). Might be a quant-aware kernel reorder introduced in the int8 path.
Alex: Action items: 1) Jin to run a git-bisect over recent quant kernel changes with this repro. 2) Add a qa tokenization smoke test for this exact sample (preserve_zwj variations). 3) Kai to look at runtime kernel fusion heuristics for int8.
Kai: Jin — run something like: `git bisect start HEAD -- <good_commit> && git bisect run ./scripts/quant-smoke.sh --repro-file tests/triage/zwj-han-ar.txt` and ping me if it points to a kernel reorder commit.
Jin: Starting bisect now. If I get a culprit I'll open a PR with a targeted unit test and a failing-case in our detok test harness. Will update here. :mechanical_arm:
Maria: I'll attach the top 5 failing examples from eval set to the ticket so we can triage priority.
Alex: Nice — also add a small note to the onboard checklist for solace-v1 quant: run multilingual-zwj-smoke.
Sophia: FYI — I remember a similar bracket/ellipsis hit in a vertical-layout bringup a month ago; might be related to the same kernel flag. cc @ml-ops
Jin: thanks all. I'll post the bisect result + a short diff if I find it.
Alex: Thanks — throwing :thumbsup: here.
(END)
